## Policy

We prefer **issues first**. We are not accepting unsolicited PRs right now.

If you want to contribute, [open an issue](https://github.com/checkmarble/ego-graph/issues/new/choose) describing the bug or change. Maintainers will triage and may invite you to collaborate or open a draft PR.

Bot PRs (Dependabot, etc.) are welcome.
